ideas.title: Following the Money in Health Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in recent health care fraud cases, including the $50m investigation in California.
questions: How did the perpetrators of the health care fraud scheme launder their money?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of how health care fraud schemes operate and how to prevent them in the future.

ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Investigations on Local Communities
ideas.description: Examine the impact of federal investigations on local communities, including the recent investigation into the Kansas City Mayor Pro Tem.
questions: How do federal investigations affect local businesses and residents?
What are the long-term consequences of federal investigations on local communities?
ideas.insight: Federal investigations can have a significant impact on local communities, and it's essential to understand the effects of these investigations to ensure that justice is served and that communities are protected.
